title: Gateway conversation prompt
responsibility: Formats ordered conversation input as the gateway continuation prompt.

inputs.name: gatewayPrompt.request
inputs.description: Request whose input array contains the complete ordered conversation history; model, stream, tools and instructions do not change the prompt.

outputs.name: gatewayPrompt
outputs.description: Instruction text followed by JSON.stringify of request.input, asking continuation from the latest user request with role and tool context.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: An input accessor error propagates unchanged.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: A nullish request or a history that JSON cannot serialize, such as a cycle or BigInt, throws.

examples.subject: gatewayPrompt
examples.name: Preserve user and tool output order
